boundary: Pass 5960 is an identity verified at seven values of q and constructed directly at q=4 over GF(4). It concerns the COUNTING split only -- the geometry the split sits in is symplectic at even q and orthogonal at odd q, per Pass 5936. Pass 5963 records a NON-relation and asserts nothing

pass_5960_the_general_split.meaning: the nonzero 2x2 matrices over F_q, modulo scalars, split into SINGULAR classes forming Q+(3,q) with (q+1)^2 points, and UNIT classes numbering q(q^2-1)

pass_5961_what_this_says_about_their_res.so: their two-qubit identification survives intact; what does not survive is the reading that 9+6 is itself a two-qubit signature. The signature is the symplectic ambient, not the split
pass_5961_what_this_says_about_their_res.the_correction_of_emphasis: the SPLIT is not special to q=2 -- it is the q=2 case of (q^2+1)(q+1) = (q+1)^2 + q(q^2-1), and the singular part is Q+(3,q) at every q. 9+6, 16+24, 25+60, 36+120 are one family
pass_5961_what_this_says_about_their_res.their_claim: M_2(F_2) splits 15 = 9 rank-one + 6 units, the two-qubit 9+6
pass_5961_what_this_says_about_their_res.what_IS_special_at_q_2: not the counting but the AMBIENT GEOMETRY. Pass 5936 proved the determinant polarization is alternating only in characteristic 2, so only there does the split sit inside a SYMPLECTIC space W(3,2). At odd q the same numbers sit inside an orthogonal geometry

pass_5963_a_non_relation.question: are the 1+3+3 stabiliser orbits and the 360/2880 triple orbits related?
pass_5963_a_non_relation.the_objects: C3 x C6 of order 18 acting on the 7 points of ONE heptad, versus Sp(4,3) of order 51840 acting on 3240 triples
pass_5963_a_non_relation.why_i_am_saying_so_explicitly: both decompositions contain threes, and asserting a connection from that is exactly the coincidence pattern this session has killed eleven times. The threes are the field characteristic appearing twice
